title: TikTok Shop Affiliate: A Current Guide for Sellers and Creators
summary: Understand TikTok Shop seller collaborations, creator affiliate participation, eligibility, commissions, disclosure, measurement, and related monetization programs.
body_markdown:
## How seller affiliate collaboration works


The official[Affiliate Collaboration guide](https://seller-us.tiktok.com/university/essay?default_language=en&identity=1&knowledge_id=6837873164896001) presents two main seller routes:


### Open Collaboration


A seller makes selected eligible products available to the broader pool of eligible TikTok Shop creators. Depending on current settings, the seller may require approval before a creator participates. Open collaboration can expand discovery, but the seller still needs product qualification, sensible economics, accurate listing information, inventory control, sample rules, and creator review.


### Target Collaboration


A seller invites selected creators to promote specific products. This model supports tighter partner selection and customized terms. A creator must accept the invitation before proceeding. Current TikTok Shop documentation explains how overlapping open and target terms are prioritized; sellers should confirm the active term displayed for each creator and product rather than relying on an old spreadsheet.


### Seller responsibilities


Before launch, calculate contribution after product cost, discounts, shipping support, platform charges, samples, creator compensation, cancellations, and returns. Confirm that inventory and fulfillment can support promotion. Supply accurate product claims, prohibited-claim guidance, disclosure instructions, review expectations, and a contact for problems. Do not raise or reduce terms in a way that contradicts accepted agreements or the platform's effective-date rules.
